第5章打架带个球怎木了
新书求推荐，求收藏，各种求.已签约，请放心投资。
※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
华十二刚和老科交代了一句，便感觉视线开始模糊，耳边球场纷乱的声音似乎渐渐远去。
黑暗袭来，意识好似被抽离。
当再次清醒过来的时候，听到的是山呼海啸的欢呼声，华十二发现自己还是站在球场上，但刚刚比赛加打架的疲累一扫而空，整个人重新充满了力量，精神身体也恢复到了最佳状态。
他身旁是老科，然后周围还站着湖人队的队友，小鱼费舍尔也在其中。
但与之前不同的是，片刻之前还是马赛克队的主场，而这一次看到的是紫金色的赛场。
就在他完全清醒过来的时候，一段记忆迅速被他吸收，这是01赛季沙克·奥尼尔的相关记忆。
接收了这段记忆，华十二知道这是事件二已经开启了。
现在的时间节点应该是01赛季总决赛第一场，洛城湖人vs费城76人的比赛，地点是湖人队的主场‘斯台普斯中心’。
此时比赛还未开始，湖人队和76人队的先发五人都走入球场准备开球。
做为总决赛的第一场，今天的比赛可谓举世瞩目，全球近两百个国家和地区，使用四十多种语言来直播或转播本场比赛。
球场内星光熠熠，场边坐满了许多前来观战的各路明星，‘华十二’装模作样和队友一起朝球迷挥手的时候，甚至一眼就看见了正当红的小甜甜布兰妮，影帝尼克尔森等大明星。
当华十二的目光朝场边就坐的明星望过去的时候，就听见有人大声喊道：
“沙克，我是你的球迷！”
华十二循声看去，就见大明星史泰龙和日后当了州长的终结者都站在场边，正激动的朝他招手，他笑着朝那边挥挥手，大声喊道：
“西尔维斯特，阿诺德，我也是你们的影迷！”
两个荧幕硬汉笑的都合不拢嘴了，再次喊道：
“沙克，干掉他们，就像你干掉查尔斯·巴克利那样！”

咦.，什么叫就像干掉巴克利那样？
这不怪他觉得奇怪，因为若是现实世界，别人绝对不会这么说，这种话怕是只会对巴克利去说，毕竟媒体报道可是奥胖被揍了。
华十二心中一动，难道事件一和事件二的时间线是相连的？
他先朝兰博和终结者做了个ok的手势，然后转头朝身边的科比低声问道：
“最近坐直升机了吗？“
科比闻言脸色一黑，郁闷道：
“嘿沙克，别提这件事了好么，上次和瓦妮莎去科罗拉多大峡谷玩，因为我不坐直升机，直到现在她还笑话我是胆小鬼呢，真后悔答应你这么无聊的要求！”
华十二闻言不由得哈哈笑了起来，被老婆笑胆小总比以后出事强，科比的回答证实了他的猜想，事件一和事件二的时间线，的确是相连的。
这时候比赛双方的球员都走到中场准备开球。
一个身穿黑色的76人3号球衣，梳着地垄沟发型的小个子，气场十足的走过来和奥尼尔与科比打招呼。
华十二眼睛一亮，立刻就认出了对方的身份。
阿伦艾弗森！
联盟历史上最伟大的三号，也是他篮球方面的偶像，嗯之一。
若是异地相处，他不是奥胖，此处也不是即将开赛的总决赛战场的话，他肯定会第一时间跑过去找阿伦要签名。
不过这个时候，对华十二来说，最重要的事情不是找阿伦要签名，而是在这一场击败他，让湖人队横扫76人。
和艾佛森击了下手掌，华十二笑着道：
“嘿，阿伦，做好被我们横扫的准备了么！”
艾弗森露出桀骜的笑容：
“沙克，你知道垃圾话对我是没用的，在球场上我不惧怕任何人，同样不惧怕任何挑战！”
华十二没有说话，而是朝艾弗森竖起拇指，这不代表奥尼尔，而是代表他自己，真心的！

双方球员落位，湖人先发五人，费舍尔、科比、福克斯、格兰特、奥尼尔。

※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
As soon as Hua Twelve said something to Corvo, his vision began to blur, and the chaotic sounds of the stadium in his ears seemed to gradually fade away.
Darkness came over me, and my consciousness seemed to be pulled away.
When he woke up again, he heard the cheers of mountains and tsunamis. Hua Twelve found that he was still standing on the court, but the fatigue from the game and fighting just now was gone. His whole body was filled with strength again, and his mental and physical body was restored to its best condition.
Next to him is Corvo, and then there are Lakers teammates standing around him, including fisherman Fisher.
But the difference from before is that a moment ago it was the home court of the Mosaic team, and this time it was a purple and gold stadium.
Just when he was fully awake, a memory was quickly absorbed by him. This was a memory related to Shaquille O'Neal in the 2001 season.
After receiving this memory, Hua Twelve knew that this was the start of event two.
The current time point should be the first game of the 2001 season finals, the Los Angeles Lakers vs. Philadelphia 76ers game. The venue is the Lakers' home stadium, Staples Center.
The game had not yet started, and the starting five of the Lakers and 76ers all walked onto the court to prepare for the kickoff.
As the first game of the finals, today's game has attracted worldwide attention. Nearly 200 countries and regions around the world have used more than 40 languages ​​to broadcast or broadcast this game live.
The stadium was star-studded, and the sidelines were filled with celebrities from all walks of life who came to watch the game. When "Hua Twelve" pretended to wave to the fans with his teammates, he even saw the popular Britney Spears, actor Nicholson and other big stars at a glance.
When Hua Twelve looked at the celebrities sitting on the sidelines, he heard someone shouting:
"Shaq, I'm your fan!"
Hua Twelve followed the sound and saw the famous star Stallone and Terminator, who would later become the governor, standing on the sidelines, waving to him excitedly. He smiled and waved over there, shouting:
"Sylvester, Arnold, I'm a fan of yours too!"
The two tough guys on screen laughed so hard that they shouted again:
"Shaq, kill them like you killed Charles Barkley!"
Hey, what do you mean, it's like killing Barkley?
It's no wonder that he found it strange, because in the real world, others would never say that. I'm afraid this kind of thing would only be said to Barkley. After all, the media reported that Ao Pang was beaten.
Hua Twelve's heart moved. Could it be that the timelines of event one and event two are connected?
He first made an OK gesture to Rambo and the Terminator, then turned to Kobe beside him and asked in a low voice:
“Have you been on a helicopter lately?”
Kobe's face darkened when he heard this, and he said depressedly:
"Hey Shaq, please don't mention this. Last time I went to the Grand Canyon with Vanessa. Because I didn't fly in a helicopter, she still laughs at me for being a coward. I really regret agreeing to such a boring request of yours!"
Hua Twelve couldn't help laughing when he heard this. It was better to be laughed at by his wife for being timid than to have an accident later. Kobe's answer confirmed his suspicion that the timelines of incident one and incident two were indeed connected.
At this time, players from both sides of the game walked to the midfield to prepare for the kickoff.
A little man wearing a black No. 3 jersey of the 76ers and a slicked-down hairstyle came over with great aura and greeted O'Neal and Kobe.
Hua Twelve's eyes lit up and he immediately recognized the other party's identity.
Allen Iverson!
The greatest No. 3 in league history and one of his basketball idols.
If they were in a different place, if he was not a fat man, and this was not the battlefield for the upcoming finals, he would definitely run over to Allen for an autograph as soon as possible.
But thisAt this time, the most important thing for Hua Twelve was not to ask Allen for his autograph, but to defeat him in this game and let the Lakers sweep the 76ers.
After hitting Iverson's palms, Hua Twelve smiled and said:
"Hey, Allen, are you ready to be swept away by us?"
Iverson showed an unruly smile:
"Shaq, you know trash talk is useless to me. I'm not afraid of anyone on the court, and I'm not afraid of any challenges!"
Hua Twelve did not speak, but gave Iverson a thumbs up. This does not represent O'Neal, but represents himself, sincerely!
The players on both sides were in position, with the Lakers starting five, Fisher, Kobe, Fox, Grant, and O'Neal.
